info.title: CIDEF Agent Motor Lab
info.description: Read-only Action surface dedicated to the CIDEF agent at /api/custom-gpt. Exposes controlled RAW + MASTER exploration and deterministic business motors, including expectation, monthly and daily cutoff-safe sales context, product sales and recognized product detail, canonical sales identity coverage, runtime organizational sales context, organizational share expectation backtesting with null-safe relative-gap detail, productive organizational relative performance over closed months using certified grain-specific baselines, shared competitive context with optional Chile market-origin peer filtering, bounded competitive share trajectory with compact trajectory and explicit monthly detail outputs over the same peer semantics, canonical product GENERATION membership context, bounded organization sales deterioration backtesting with sparse observation semantics, and an AUDIT_ONLY observation-semantics comparison with explicit ACTIVE_ZERO evidence and temporal/unit-universe validations for Family 3. No free SQL, no DDL/DML, and no use of the legacy multi-tenant /api/router surface.

post.summary: Run one read-only deterministic action through the dedicated CIDEF agent endpoint

ActionInput.description: Action-specific input. product_generation_context_v01 accepts optional modelo_id, version_id, generation_id, membership_status, include_evidence and a bounded limit; it reads canonical GENERATION identity/membership only and never performs backfill. ventas_identity_coverage_v01, expected_monthly_backtest_v01 and expected_monthly_stability_v01 use an empty object. ventas_daily_context_v01 requires cutoff_date and exposes the cutoff-safe recognized-sales snapshot without organizational filtering or forecasting. ventas_organizational_context_v01 requires start_month and end_month. organizational_share_expectation_backtest_v01 requires grain, start_month, end_month and candidate_baselines; monthly detail returns relative_gap_pp=null whenever expected_share is unavailable/non-evaluable. organizational_relative_performance_v01 requires only grain, start_month and end_month; v0.1 is CURRENT_SNAPSHOT only, rejects open months and laboratory/cutoff knobs, and applies fixed certified baselines median_3 for tienda and moving_average_5 for vendedor. ventas_product_sales_v01 and ventas_product_detail_v01 require modelo_id, start_month, end_month and cutoff_month=end_month. competitive_context_v01 and competitive_share_trajectory_v01 require target_model_ids, date_from and date_to; geography and origin_group are optional. competitive_share_trajectory_v01 defaults to output_mode=trajectory; output_mode=monthly requires entity_keys. org_sales_deterioration_backtest_v01 requires grain, start_month, end_month and the three candidate arrays; deterioration v0.4 uses sparse observation semantics: tienda uses NV-backed ACTIVE_ZERO while other missing months remain UNKNOWN and vendedor stays positive-only/UNKNOWN until independent activity evidence exists. org_sales_observation_semantics_audit_v01 is AUDIT_ONLY/DISCOVERY_ONLY, requires only start_month and end_month, fixes tienda + last_year + relative + deepening_2, accepts detail_limit plus optional detail_unit_id, and exposes bounded ACTIVE_ZERO unit-month evidence plus explicit temporal and unit-universe validations.

limit.description: Generic result bound. product_generation_context_v01 enforces a stricter maximum of 200 rows.

start_month.description: Start month for deterministic monthly motors, format YYYY-MM

end_month.description: End month for deterministic monthly motors, format YYYY-MM

cutoff_month.description: Last month whose ventas_raw evidence may be used by cutoff-aware sales and expectation motors

cutoff_date.description: Inclusive calendar cutoff for ventas_daily_context_v01. Backend requires a valid YYYY-MM-DD date and applies it before LAST-by-VIN recognition.

target_month.description: Target month. For expected_monthly_candidates_v01 it must immediately follow cutoff_month; for ventas_monthly_actual_v01 it must be <= cutoff_month

dominant_first_customers.description: FIRST customer codes treated as resolved-to-LAST by residual Family 1 motors

modelo_id.description: Canonical modelo_id used by product sales/detail and optional product GENERATION filtering

version_id.description: Optional canonical version_id filter for product_generation_context_v01

generation_id.description: Optional canonical generation_id filter for product_generation_context_v01

include_evidence.description: When true, product_generation_context_v01 also returns bounded generation_evidence_v01 rows

target_model_ids.description: Current CIDEF modelo_id values used to derive observable runtime competitive universes from RVM + MASTER

origin_group.description: Optional peer filter for competitive_context_v01 and competitive_share_trajectory_v01. Derived from the versioned Chile market-brand-origin lookup; missing origin never falls through to NON_CHINESE.

grain.description: Canonical organization grain for organizational motors

candidate_baselines.description: Caller-provided baseline candidates. organizational_share_expectation_backtest_v01 accepts last_year, moving_average_N and median_N; deterioration also supports adjusted_last_year. organizational_relative_performance_v01 does not accept this field.

candidate_persistence_rules.description: Caller-provided persistence candidates. The motor rejects frequency rules where required hits exceed window size.

output_mode.description: Action-specific output mode. competitive_share_trajectory_v01 uses trajectory by default; monthly requires entity_keys. Other motors retain their documented runtime defaults.

detail_limit.description: Maximum rows returned by bounded detail modes and audit-only evidence.

detail_unit_id.description: Optional canonical sucursal_id filter for org_sales_observation_semantics_audit_v01; applied before detail_limit.

detail_candidate.description: Optional organizational share backtest detail filter; must also appear in candidate_baselines.

detail_baseline.description: Optional deterioration detail filter; must also appear in candidate_baselines.

detail_deviation_method.description: Optional deterioration detail filter; must also appear in candidate_deviation_methods.

detail_persistence_rule.description: Optional deterioration detail filter; must also appear in candidate_persistence_rules.

entity_keys.description: Explicit market entity keys for competitive_share_trajectory_v01 when output_mode=monthly. Transport bound only; it does not define competitor relevance.
